title: Swanson: Chargers waste chance to seize L.A. spotlight from Rams after a debacle of an opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Swanson: Chargers waste chance to seize L.A. spotlight from Rams after a debacle of an opener
sources.description: Following the Rams' season-opening loss to the 49ers, the Chargers could have been L.A.'s only 1-0 NFL team, but they blew the assignment against the Cardinals.
